item.title: The 3 Lenses That Changed My Life and Photography
item.description: When I began my journey as a photographer some eight years ago, I relied on my kit lens to do everything. But when I joined Better Photography magazine as a junior, it shifted my perspective on why having a different lens is important. From telephotos to primes, I tested a few focal ranges that continue to shape my photography even today.
